topic: A person discovers their child has the same teacher they had
text: Well now, that’s a fine turn of events. Master Harold, he’s back teaching in the village, and it turns out little Elsie’s got him for her reading and numbers this season. I had him myself, mind you, back when the trees weren’t half as tall. He was a good one, Master Harold, always kind and patient. Even when the rain wouldn’t let up and the crops were wilting, he’d find a way to keep spirits up. Seemed like he understood the weight of the soil and the long days under the sun. I reckon Elsie’s in good hands, just like I was.
